author: classic:/root/r26_photo_booth

direct_source.interpretation: Ticket purchase point; does not identify an automatic photograph booth. The third character is 권, not 사진.
direct_source.horizontal_partial_ink: 自動... is partially cropped and by itself does not disambiguate automatic ticket machinery from a photo booth.
direct_source.white_surface: Only a cropped white surface and metallic jamb are visible; a fabric curtain is NOT established.

independent_actual_continuous_source.observation: Same kind of cobalt-blue curved ticket-bank side screen beside explicit 승차권사는곳 and 승차권교환반환 signs, ticket machine bank and independent white rail kiosk. No photographer seat/camera/curtain or photo-selection/payment controls are evidenced.
independent_actual_continuous_source.qualification: The retained route is public2023 source, not proof of current2026 equipment make. Current2026 source lettering independently establishes ticket purpose.

actual_geometry_authoring.qualification: Empty geometry is not purpose or equipment placement proof.

construction_decision: Do not create a photo booth, curtain, seat, camera or associated PHOTO wording. Reclassify this investigation as the nursery-adjacent ticket-vending bank side screen; construct only after source-facing machinery/quantity and structural envelope are established. Existing self-ticket source work may be reusable, but the two installation locations must not be conflated.
